mentions.name: Grafily
mentions.description: An Obsidian plugin for building and rendering family tree graphs for genealogy research. It visualizes family member relationships as an interactive tree/graph view (similar to myheritage.com's viewer) directly inside Obsidian, so genealogy data stays local instead of being stored on a third-party platform.
mentions.problem: Genealogy data typically must be stored on third-party platforms like myheritage.com, and Obsidian lacked a tree/graph viewer for family member relationships; the author wanted a private, local alternative.
mentions.audience: Genealogy researchers who want to keep family research data local and private
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on the Obsidian plugin for building and rendering family graphs [1]. I started my own genealogy research in 2025 and did not want to store data on a 3rd-party platform.
